name: glb-designer-stage6a
description: Asset Studio Iteration 2 Stage 6a — content expansion in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Arm the new 'Dining chair' template, tune it, and 'Use template' — it flattens into the empty spec as one named 'Dining chair' Group (seat + legs + apron + reclined back). Screenshots from the default 3/4 iso viewport to confirm the chair reads correctly (legs plumb at the corners, seat level, back reclined). Then insert 'Wardrobe' and 'Desk' alongside (offset on +X) — three archetype Group rows. Finally arm the new 'Slat set' structural component and place it on the floor in front of the chair via the window.__glbDesignerPlaceOnFace seam — it lands as a named 'Slat set' Group. Asserts every group + part count and screenshots the chair, the trio, and the slat set.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: expand-templates
steps.comment: Expand the collapsed Templates section before interacting.

steps.name: arm-chair-template
steps.comment: Tap the new Dining chair template — its parametric step opens with the ergonomic seat/back sliders + a live preview.

steps.name: assert-chair-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Dining chair Seat height"]')) throw new Error('Seat height slider missing — chair template did not arm'); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Dining chair Back height"]')) throw new Error('Back height slider missing'); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Dining chair template"]')) throw new Error('Use template action missing'); })()

steps.name: raise-back
steps.comment: Drag the Back height slider toward 0.95 m — the live preview updates before anything is committed.
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Dining chair Back height"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '0.95'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: use-chair
steps.comment: Insert the flattened dining chair. The empty spec is REPLACED; the 'Dining chair' group is selected.

steps.name: assert-chair-group
steps.comment: One 'Dining chair' group row appears and it is selected (its Edit-group panel is up).
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); if (names.filter(t => t === 'Dining chair').length !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 Dining chair group row, got ' + names.filter(t=>t==='Dining chair').length); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="group position X"]')) throw new Error('inserted group not selected (Edit-group fields missing)'); })()

steps.name: shot-chair
steps.comment: 3/4 iso view of the chair — legs must be plumb at the four corners, the seat level, the back reclined.

steps.name: arm-wardrobe-template
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Start from Wardrobe template"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Wardrobe template button not found'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-wardrobe-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Wardrobe template"]')) throw new Error('Wardrobe template did not arm'); })()

steps.name: use-wardrobe
steps.comment: Insert alongside — the spec is non-empty, so the wardrobe lands offset on +X.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Wardrobe template"]'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: arm-desk-template
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Start from Desk template"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Desk template button not found'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-desk-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Desk template"]')) throw new Error('Desk template did not arm'); })()

steps.name: use-desk
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Desk template"]'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-trio
steps.comment: Three archetype Group rows now: Dining chair + Wardrobe + Desk — all three pieces are in the spec, wardrobe + desk offset on +X.
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); for (const g of ['Dining chair','Wardrobe','Desk']) { if (names.filter(t => t === g).length !== 1) throw new Error('missing group row: ' + g); } })()

steps.name: expand-components
steps.comment: Expand the Components section and confirm the new Structure category is present.

steps.name: arm-slat-set
steps.comment: Arm the new Slat set structural component (Structure category).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Place Slat set"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Slat set component button not found (Structure category missing?)'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-slat-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Slat set armed')) throw new Error('Slat set did not arm'); if (typeof window.__glbDesignerPlaceOnFace !== 'function') throw new Error('placement seam window.__glbDesignerPlaceOnFace missing'); })()

steps.name: place-slat-set
steps.comment: Place the slat set on the floor in front of the chair (point on the ground, up normal) — a row of slats rests on the ground.

steps.name: assert-slat-group
steps.comment: One 'Slat set' group row appears — the structural component lands as a named, editable PartGroup.
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); if (names.filter(t => t === 'Slat set').length !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 Slat set group row, got ' + names.filter(t=>t==='Slat set').length); })()
